import hashlib
import json
import math
import statistics
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path


def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def record(path):
    data = path.read_bytes()
    text = data.decode('utf-8')
    return dict(sha256=digest(data), lf_sha256=digest(text.replace('\r\n', '\n').encode()), text=text)


out = Path('artifacts/performance/device-qualification-v129-checkpoint.json')
assert not out.exists()
names = [
    'cpp/cuda/internal/native_qoco_gpu.h', 'cpp/cuda/src/native_qoco_gpu.cu',
    'cpp/cuda/internal/native_qoco_adapter.h', 'cpp/cuda/src/native_qoco_adapter.cpp',
    'cpp/cuda/internal/gtoc12_qoco_qualification.cuh',
    'cpp/cuda/include/spacepdhcg/cuda/gtoc12_qoco_c_api.h',
    'cpp/cuda/src/gtoc12_qoco.cu', 'cpp/cuda/src/gtoc12_scvx.cu',
    'cpp/cuda/tests/gtoc12_scvx_test.cu', 'cpp/cuda/tests/gtoc12_device_qualification_test.cu',
]
paths = [
    '/home/angus/build-qoco-gpu-device-ir-v126/final/libqoco.so',
    '/home/angus/build-spacepdhcg-gtoc12-v128/final/libspacepdhcg_cuda.so',
    '/home/angus/build-spacepdhcg-ruiz-v77/final/spacepdhcg_plan',
    'build/performance/gtoc12_device_qualification_v129',
    'build/performance/gtoc12_scvx_v129',
]
paths += ['/home/angus/build-spacepdhcg-gtoc12-v129/final/' + name for name in
          ['libspacepdhcg_cuda.so', 'gtoc12_scvx_test', 'qoco_gpu_audit_test']]
runtimes = {name: dict(sha256=digest(Path(name).read_bytes()), bytes=Path(name).stat().st_size)
            for name in paths}
rows = json.loads(Path('artifacts/performance/device-qualification-v129-balanced-paired.json').read_text())
assert len(rows) == 18 and sum(len(r['legs']) for r in rows) == 36
assert all(r['returncode'] == 0 and all(leg['qualified'] for leg in r['legs']) for r in rows)
assert all(r['replay_calls'] > 0 for r in rows)
assert all((r['device_decisions'] > 0) == bool(r['enabled']) for r in rows)
qualifications = 0
for row in rows:
    for leg in row['legs']:
        for report in leg['reports']:
            keys = ('primal_residual', 'dual_residual', 'primal_objective', 'dual_objective', 'relative_gap')
            expected = report['qoco_status'] in (1, 2) and all(math.isfinite(report[k]) for k in keys)
            expected = expected and max(report['primal_residual'], report['dual_residual'],
                                        report['relative_gap']) <= report['requested_tolerance']
            assert bool(report['qualified']) == expected
            qualifications += 1
timing = {variant: statistics.median(r['legs'][-1]['seconds'] for r in rows if r['variant'] == variant)
          for variant in sorted({r['variant'] for r in rows})}
for mode in ['enabled', 'disabled', 'synchronous-consumer']:
    checks = json.loads(Path(f'artifacts/performance/native-replay-v129-{mode}-integration.json').read_text())
    assert all(r['returncode'] == 0 for r in checks) and '51 passed' in checks[-1]['stdout']
regression = json.loads(Path('artifacts/performance/gtoc12-native-replay-v129-regression.json').read_text())
assert regression[0]['returncode'] == 0 and '324 passed' in regression[0]['stdout']
for probe in ['unit', 'controller']:
    checks = json.loads(Path(f'artifacts/performance/device-qualification-v129-{probe}.json').read_text())
    assert all(r['returncode'] == 0 for r in checks)
    assert all('ERROR SUMMARY: 0 errors' in r['stdout'] for r in checks if r['kind'] in ['memcheck', 'initcheck', 'synccheck'])
full = json.loads(Path('artifacts/performance/native-replay-v129-full-memcheck.json').read_text())
evidence = sorted(p for p in Path('artifacts/performance').iterdir() if 'v129' in p.name and p != out)
helpers = sorted(p for p in Path('build/performance').iterdir()
                 if 'v129' in p.name and p.suffix in ['.py', '.json', '.log'])
helpers += [Path('build/performance/paired_gtoc12_scvx_v107_leg.py')]
previous = Path('artifacts/performance/native-replay-v128-checkpoint.json')
result = dict(
    source_base_commit=subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip(),
    scope='Queue GTOC12 objective/qualification and nonlinear SCvx measurement/acceptance after native replay and independent audit, before host report collection. Full host orchestration/setup removal and new fleet search remain unfinished.',
    sources={name: record(Path(name)) for name in names}, runtimes=runtimes,
    bundled_controller_test_source=subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:cpp/cuda/tests/gtoc12_scvx_test.cu'], text=True),
    helpers={str(p): record(p) for p in helpers}, evidence={str(p): record(p) for p in evidence},
    median_seconds=timing, qualified_complete_transfers=36,
    matching_reported_qualifications=qualifications,
    submitted_device_decisions=sum(r['device_decisions'] for r in rows),
    verification=dict(enabled_integration=51, disabled_integration=51, synchronous_consumer_integration=51,
                      regression=324, direct_qualification_cases=210, controller_cases_per_mode=14,
                      controller_modes=2, isolated_sanitizers=['memcheck', 'initcheck', 'synccheck'],
                      unchanged_adapter_update_d2h_limit=64),
    full_pipeline_memcheck=dict(returncode=full.get('returncode'), timeout=full.get('timeout', False)),
    failures_and_limits=[
        'Full pipeline sanitizer qualification remains unresolved; inspect the retained actual SCvx memcheck output. Isolated kernel successes do not establish full pipeline safety.',
        'Display GPU timing is variable. Medians do not establish a reliable additional end-to-end gain. All warm-ups/outliers and trace overhead are retained.',
        'Initial/stale graph priming remains synchronous; failed priming invokes no consumer. Native warm retry remains on its existing path.',
        'Final reports still wait and download. The GTOC12 bridge downloads 32 objective bytes plus the 4-byte qualification integer, outside native adapter counters.',
        'Outer SCvx host command loop, validation downloads, initial setup/analysis/vendor warm-up, per-leg reuse, batching and full mission search remain unfinished.',
        'The frozen bundled controller executable predates the added device-report test mode; the separately compiled gtoc12_scvx_v129 executable covers both modes and was sanitizer-tested.',
        'No new fleet result or leaderboard submission. The visualiser remains v11 at 12,805.194 weighted kg. Lambda is occupied by the existing campaign.',
    ],
    previous_checkpoint=dict(path=str(previous), sha256=digest(previous.read_bytes())),
)
out.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(path=str(out), bytes=out.stat().st_size, sha256=digest(out.read_bytes()),
                      median_seconds=timing, qualifications=qualifications,
                      device_decisions=result['submitted_device_decisions']), indent=2))

import json,runpy,time,sys
from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import asdict
import os
from spacepdhcg.gtoc12.low_thrust import ScvxSettings,solve_leg,certify_leg
fixture=runpy.run_path('tests/test_gtoc12_gpu_discretisation.py')
rows=[]
for repeat in range(2):
    start=time.perf_counter()
    solution=solve_leg(fixture['synthetic_boundary'](),ScvxSettings(discretisation_backend='cuda',
        assembly_backend='cuda',convex_solver_backend='qoco',outer_loop_backend=os.environ['SCVX_OUTER'],max_iterations=30,time_limit_s=30))
    seconds=time.perf_counter()-start
    certificate=certify_leg(solution)
    rows.append(dict(warmup=repeat==0,seconds=seconds,status=solution.status,mass=solution.final_mass_kg,
        qualified=bool(solution.converged and certificate.within_tolerance and abs(solution.final_mass_kg-2445.3111007852112)<=1e-5),
        certificate=asdict(certificate),outer_transfer_bytes=solution.outer_transfer_bytes,seed_backend=solution.seed_backend,reports=solution.solver_reports,history=solution.history))
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
print(rows[-1]['qualified'],rows[-1]['seconds'],flush=True)
